lines.t: Shabbat Shalom
shine forever why do you depart when sundown falls chasing the noise of the city walls
close your door but your heart swings wide the world rushes in with the morning tide
but what if this peace could stay what if we could live this way
Treat every day as a Sabbath, my friend
Let the love and stillness never end
Keep the light that your bed brings to your heart
Carry it with you, don't let it depart
Shabbat shalom
The candles flicker, the wine runs deep But the spirit's joy is ours to keep
From sunset glow to morning new Let the Sabbath live in all you do
Hear the song through the days ahead Let that peace be your daily bread
Treat every day as a Sabbath, my friend
Let the love and stillness never end
Keep the light that your bed brings to your heart
Carry it with you, don't let it depart
Six days may spin and the hours may fly
But hold that calm in your heart inside
Every moment, every breath you take
Let it honor the rest you made
Treat every day as a Sabbath, my friend
Let the circle of peace transcend
Keep the flame at the Sabbath stars
Light up the world with a thousand hearts
Shabbat shalom
Every day I know
The Sabbath lives inside of you
Shabbat Shalom
Thank you.
